QUOTE: "It is the only thing that writes the pointers, and the only caller in the library is the memory-buffer allocator." and "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` ... installs its own `buffer_alloc_calloc` / `buffer_alloc_free`, or the `_mutexed` variants when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on, through `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the memory-buffer allocator is the only in-library caller of the setter and that its init function installs its own calloc/free through it.
